title: coord.py announces a session's intent and progress, and a digest gives a reader only the live work that overlaps its keys
goal: coord.py post accepts two more closed kinds, intent (fields session, item, topic and touch: a session's item ids, topic keys and touch globs) and progress (fields item and state, one of working, blocked, done), each with id-only fields under the field limit; coord.py digest --key K (repeatable) --lines N prints at most N lines of the live intents, claims and research topics that overlap the given keys, newest first, and never one whose claim was released, whose lease expired or whose item is done; kb/_self/tools.md says which kind each step posts and that a reader injects only digest output, never raw events.

run:
import os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,time
T="_tools/coord.py"
if not os.path.isfile(T):print("coord.py missing: the work adds it");sys.exit(1)
E=dict(os.environ,KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(),"coord.sqlite"))
def c(*a):
    p=s.run([sys.executable,T,*a],capture_output=True,text=True,env=E,timeout=60);return p.returncode,p.stdout,p.stderr
def post(k,**f):
    a=[]
    for n,v in f.items():a+=["--field",n+"="+v]
    return c("post","--kind",k,*a)[0]
ok=[post("intent",item="ST-aaaaaaaa",topic="agents/x",touch="_tools/coord.py"),post("intent",item="ST-bbbbbbbb",topic="mcp/y"),
 post("intent",item="ST-cccccccc",topic="agents/x"),post("progress",item="ST-cccccccc",state="done"),post("progress",item="ST-aaaaaaaa",state="working"),post("intent",item="ST-ffffffff",topic="agents/x")]
import json
tok=json.loads(c("claim","agents/x","--ttl","60","--holder","released-one")[1])["token"];c("release","agents/x","--token",tok)
c("claim","agents/x","--ttl","1","--holder","expired-one");time.sleep(1.6);c("claim","agents/x","--ttl","60","--holder","live-one")
bad=c("post","--kind","progress","--field","item=ST-aaaaaaaa","--field","state=sleeping")[0]
d=c("digest","--key","agents/x","--lines","5")[1];d1=c("digest","--key","agents/x","--lines","1")[1]
lines=[l for l in d.splitlines() if l.strip()]
res=dict(kinds_posted=ok==[0]*6,bad_state_exit2=bad==2,overlap_shown="ST-aaaaaaaa" in d and "live-one" in d,newest_first="ST-ffffffff" in d and "ST-aaaaaaaa" in d and d.index("ST-ffffffff")<d.index("ST-aaaaaaaa"),no_overlap_hidden="ST-bbbbbbbb" not in d,
 done_hidden="ST-cccccccc" not in d,released_hidden="released-one" not in d,expired_hidden="expired-one" not in d,
 line_budget=len(lines)<=5 and len([l for l in d1.splitlines() if l.strip()])<=1)
print(res,"\n"+d);sys.exit(0 if all(res.values()) else 1)

import re,sys
t=open("kb/_self/tools.md",encoding="utf-8").read()
part=[p for p in re.split(r"\n(?=#)",t) if "coord.py digest" in p]
need=["intent","progress","claim","digest"]
ok=bool(part) and all(w in part[0] for w in need) and re.search(r"only (the )?digest output|never raw events",part[0])
print("tools.md section naming coord.py digest:",bool(part),"| names kinds and the digest-only rule:",bool(ok));sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
